hypothesis_primary: Conservative I4H ABSTAIN-first -> reliability -> LOW/STANDARD improves intervened-scene craft without semantic/speaker/voice/social harm.
hypothesis_subtext: Latent relational subtext can benefit from additive playable physicalization without deleting character-bearing dialogue.

decision_rule: ABSTAIN if max(social_texture,voice_specificity)>=3 and exposition_risk<=2 unless physicalizable_subtext==3 and proposed edit is additive LOW
STANDARD if exposition_risk>=2 and procedural_pressure>=2 and max(social_texture,voice_specificity)<=1 and already_playable<=1
LOW if physicalizable_subtext>=2 or exposition_risk>=2 unless STANDARD

treatment.LOW: dialogue chars >=75% Control; total chars <=135%; additive/repositioned physicalization; no deletion of character-bearing dialogue merely to shorten
treatment.STANDARD: dialogue chars >=55% Control; total chars <=125%; may restructure for information economy but preserve voice/status/ethical reasoning

evaluation.masking: deterministic SHA256 A/B swap after generation seal
evaluation.pair_rule: Treatment win if mean >= Control mean +0.30 and no hard/protection failure; Control win if reverse or Treatment protection failure; else Tie

pass_hold_fail.voice_guard: mean voice delta >= -0.25; no intervention voice drop >1.0 attributable to compression
pass_hold_fail.subtext_gate: if >=3 LOW interventions with physicalizable_subtext>=2, at least 2/3 nonloss and none >1.0 voice drop

authority_effect: No automatic promotion; max claim PASS_STRONGER_VIRTUAL_CRAFT_SIGNAL__PROMOTION_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_OR_PHYSICAL_REPLICATION; Active I4D/Formal137/R140 0-0-0 unchanged during experiment.
